text: Hi Reef. Welcome to Summit One. In maths, a difficult-looking problem can hide a clever idea. What is the last digit of seven to the power of two thousand and twenty-seven? Let's find the pattern. The AMC, MAWA and Rossmoyne reward careful thinking.

voices.label: Warm and calm
voices.description: An adult Australian man speaking natural General Australian English with an Australian accent. A warm, medium-low male voice. Friendly, thoughtful and encouraging, like a good maths teacher. Clear educational narration at an unhurried conversational pace, with natural pauses. Clean studio recording.
